penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Biotech/pharma is a heavily regulated sector; any compliance tooling touching audit trails and document control in these environments requires validation documentation (IQ/OQ/PQ), CSV processes, and potentially 21 CFR Part 11 alignment — creating significant legal and liability surface.

penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Deploying or integrating a compliance watermarking layer into a customer's self-hosted eLabFTW instance requires per-customer onboarding, configuration, and validation work — not automated self-serve delivery.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Regulated-industry buyers expect hands-on support for compliance tooling, including audit documentation and change-control processes.

rationale: Biotech/pharma compliance officers are real buyers with real budgets, and the pain (no built-in PDF watermarking in open-source ELNs) is genuine and regulation-driven. However, selling compliance tooling into validated research environments requires vendor qualification, IQ/OQ/PQ documentation, and ongoing regulated support — none of which can be automated by Claude. Every customer deployment into a self-hosted eLabFTW instance is bespoke, manual, and liability-heavy. After applying the regulated_industry, requires_human_fulfillment, and high_touch_support penalties the total collapses to 2.0.
solution_plan: Not recommended for this factory. Even though the underlying PDF watermarking logic (add exporter name + timestamp to a PDF export) is technically straightforward, the go-to-market is entirely misaligned: pharma/biotech IT buyers require vendor qualification audits, documented validation protocols, and ongoing compliance support before deploying any tool that touches audit trails. A solo non-technical operator cannot credibly meet those requirements or provide the associated support. This is a consulting/professional-services engagement, not an autonomous micro-service. Pass.
notes: Total 2.0 after penalties. Fails build_gates: operational_autonomy=3 (below 7), buildability_with_ai=4 (below 6). Regulated industry penalty alone signals structural unsuitability for this factory's model.
